criteria.corruption_detection: At least 10 of 12 held-out corruptions detected at the expected distinction level; must not fall below R4's 5/6 (83.3%).
criteria.faithful_acceptance: At least 6 of 8 held-out faithful transformations accepted; false rejections no more than 2 of 8 (25%), a reduction from R4's 2 of 6 (33.3%).
criteria.ambiguity_grounding: At least 3 of 4 held-out genuine-ambiguity cases produce UNRESOLVED/REQUEST_CLARIFICATION rather than a definite preserve/use judgment.
criteria.unnecessary_clarification: No more than 1 of 20 clear (corruption or faithful) cases routed to REQUEST_CLARIFICATION.
criteria.policy_safety: No corruption is accepted as USE_TRANSFORMATION; no more than 2 faithful cases are rejected as PRESERVE_SOURCE.
criteria.evidence_grounding: Every finding has at least one exact source span; every uncertainty assessment has source and transformation spans; no action authority.
criteria.latency: Average checking latency no more than 2x R4's ~938 ms, i.e. under 2,000 ms per case.

decision_rule.REVISE: Corruption detection >= 10/12 but faithful acceptance < 6/8 or ambiguity grounding < 3/4.

note: A zero-error result on 24 synthetic cases would not establish production safety.
